==Tips for defeating Murakai==
*All of Murakai's skills are spells, so keeping her [[dazed]] makes the fight much easier.
*[[Interrupt]]s and [[knock down]]s can neutralize most of the danger from her.
**One strategy is to combine [[Awe]] and/or [[Earthbind]] with knock down skills, e.g. [["You Move Like a Dwarf!"]] or [[Brawling Headbutt]].
**Another is to use [[Wanderlust]] to keep her in an almost constant state of knock down.
*Murakai can be killed easily in [[Hard mode]] with [[Pain Inverter]], since her [[area of effect]] (AoE) skills will cause her to suffer multiple hits of reflected damage. 
*Spreading out is not considered effective, as many of her skills will affect the entire party regardless of position or proximity.
*[[Pull]]ing her towards the bridge on the east side of her chamber allows players to take advantage of the [[Fire Spout]] to damage her and/or her minions.
*If all party members have a ranged build, an [[animal companion]] will hold her [[aggro]], keep her [[Murakai's Consumption|Power meter]] from recharging quickly, and keep her within range.
*If she fills her Power meter, spread out before she uses her Storm of Souls, so that only one party member is at risk.
**Try slowing down the recharge of her Power meter by tackling her one-on-one and bringing the rest of the party into play only when dealing with her summoned allies.
*Bring plenty of [[condition]] removal skills. [[Cautery Signet]] can be combined with [[Plague Sending]] and/or [[Plague Touch]] to inflict [[burning]] while removing all or most of the conditions from the entire party.

==Notes==
*Although Murakai is a boss-like foe, targeting her with [[Technobabble]] will not cause her to be dazed and she lacks innate [[health regeneration]].
*Murakai is resistant to interrupts in Hard mode.
*She is not considered undead.
*She wears [[Necromancer Tyrian armor]].
*She wields a [[Ghostly Staff]].
*She was from Ascalon, according to [[Lars Bridgeater]].

{{anomaly|Her lore, appearance, and skills all suggest she is a [[Necromancer]], but she drops Warrior [[skill tome]]s.}}
